purpose: Teach: オッサン/のら/てぇ/きき/フツー/おぉ/ムッ/ヘビー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、自分を「オッサン」と笑いながら自称されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was calling himself an old man and laughing about it.
lines.style: Wry, half-amused observation. Soft lead-in on the name. Slight smile in the voice — noticing something human in the absurdity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の前にのら猫が来てるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: There's a stray cat hanging around in front of the shop.
lines.style: Gentle shift of attention. Noticing something small and vulnerable. Voice lifts slightly — not urgent, but present. Warm curiosity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「ちょてぇ」って関西言葉ご使用だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was using Kansai dialect — saying things like "chotee."
lines.style: Observant, almost thoughtful pause. Catching the specific texture of how someone speaks. Light, not judgmental — cataloguing the detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご自身の体調のききに敏感でいらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He was really tuned in to how his body was feeling — very aware of himself.
lines.style: Noting something perceptive about the customer's self-awareness. Quiet admiration underneath. Steady, reflective pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、フツーの一日のお客様サービスでも工夫が必要ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Even on a normal day, taking care of customers takes real intentionality.
lines.style: Soft directional weight. Not critical — gently affirming that what Aoi does matters. Warm encouragement, not instruction.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「おぉ、香り良い」と感嘆されたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He really appreciated the coffee — said something like "oh, the aroma is wonderful."
lines.style: Pleased recognition. Voice brightens on the aroma moment. Sharing something that went right. Genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、待ち時間にムッとされた表情をされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: But he did look a little frustrated during the wait.
lines.style: Gentle concern noted quietly. Not accusatory — just observing what was on his face. Thoughtful, protective attention to detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、シフトがヘビーになりすぎないように調整しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's make sure your shifts don't get too heavy, okay?
lines.style: Caring directional note. Soft but steady. Not patronizing — genuine check-in that her wellbeing matters. Close and intimate.
